The Reserve Bank of India anticipates inflation will peak this quarter, supporting future bond market performance.

supporting_news.title: Oil slide, Treasury strength boost Indian bonds
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds experienced an increase due to a significant decline in crude oil prices. A Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections raised hopes for peace in the Middle East. Traders responded positively, adding positions in government bonds as yields softened. Concerns about inflation risks diminished as investors anticipated a delay in interest rate hikes. Market dynamics indicate that Qatar-led mediation efforts are being monitored closely amid these developments.
